scene_description: Promotional image for a home improvement company featuring a worker carrying a window frame outdoors, combined with a Google customer review and branding elements.

attributes.pose: walking away from camera while carrying a window frame
clothing: light gray long-sleeve shirt with company logo on back

attributes.position: left side, being carried by worker

attributes.text: Salesman was very nice and knowledgeable and gave us a great price. Beat four other quotes that we got, And I was looking for the best value not the lowest price. Installation was fast trouble free and very quick. The installation crew went out of their way to help me out and make everything go trouble-free and easy. It's been 6 months now and we are very happy with the product and the Service. We bought these windows mainly to reduce noise. And they did a very good job of that and they looked great. I would definitely recommend Brothers to anybody that is looking to upgrade their windows.
